chitchat: reads a bearing off his slate and thumbs it through to the gun.
"Low and slow, they said. They always come in low and slow."
description: A Coldwater spotter with a slate of overlapping radar returns and a headset clamped to one ear. He calls bearings to the gunner in a flat, bored monotone.

bye.text: They turn back to the guns and the sky.

root.text: They keep one eye on the sky. "Unless you're here to help work the guns, you're in the way. Move."

name: a Guardian battery spotter
